reviews.text: Thank you "fur" the review! 🐕 …

I had a great experience at Banfield Pet Hospital in Northridge. The entire staff was friendly, welcoming, and provided wonderful service from start to finish. The veterinarian was very helpful, took the time to answer all of my questions, and made sure my pet received excellent care. I truly appreciate the professionalism and compassion of everyone on the team. I highly recommend Banfield Pet Hospital in Northridge to anyone looking for quality veterinary care.
Hi Rachel - It was a pleasure caring for your furry friend. Thanks for the great rating! Please let us know if you have any suggestions on how we can make your next experience with us even better.

I have been bringing my dogs to this Banfield since 2014 or so (when they used to be in PetSmart accross the street.) And now we go to their freestanding location in the shopping plaza just across the street from PetSmart.

Jeremy always recognizes and takes great care checking in Sonic and Señor. Sonic hates the vet and isn't comfortable with strangers but after years of going here he is finally OK with Jeremy LOL.
Dr. Del Pino is very communicative and informative. I trust her with caring for my pups. They have been going here since I rescued them in 2015 & 2016 when they were both under 1 year old.

They helped me for years with my dog Tanner's condition and were very helpful and understanding with the difficult decision I finally had to make to put Tanner down in 2015 after years of care.

I have never felt like they pressured me into anything that my dogs didn't need. And I feel their recommended suggestions have helped my dogs have a happy and enriching life.

My late dog Tanner had a Banfield care plan and my current pups are also on
Optimal Wellness Plans - Active Care Plus. These plans that Banfield offers are so helpful and the app is useful too. I have been able to show new dog groomers that my pups are up to date on their rabies shots by downloading their records from the app.

I trust this Banfield location and I recommend putting your pets on an Optimal Wellness Plan with Banfield.

Adding more on 7/20/26:
This is still the best Banfield location around!
5 stars to Dr. DelPino & Jeremy 🙌
Pets always get great care. Team is responsive and caring. Dr. Delpino ia wonderful.

I took my dog for a dental cleaning to this hospital, and I had a great experience. The entire staff was friendly, welcoming, and very helpful throughout the visit. Dr. Moghadam was knowledgeable, informative, and highly professional, taking the time to explain everything clearly. I'm very happy with the care my dog received and with the results.

Don't do it! Yelp score is more realistic because 4 stars is way too generous.  Worst care I've ever received for any of my dogs.  I'll never come back here,  I suggest you don't either. The receptionist was rude and dismissive. Talked to my husband like he was an idiot. Didn't tell us it was a drop off appointment when I made the appointment.  When they called me to pick up my dog they gave ZERO explanation as to what test they preformed and the outcome.  I had to call back to ask to speak to the vet. When they called they just asked for more money for more test without touching on anything previously preformed.  I don't trust them.  They come off sneaky and dishonest.  Read the other reviews. Other ppl said similar.  If you love your baby,  this vet isn't for you
Poor communication. Admitted that they were in the wrong, but refused to do anything to make it right. Poor experience with the front desk staff.

There are many Banfield locations across Los Angeles, but this one is our favorite because I really feel like they always answer our questions properly and give us the best options and they’re great about getting our pet in.

I wish I could leave a non-star rating.
I’ve trusted Banfield since my dog was 6 weeks old and always had good experiences—until now.
On March 11, my dog became ill. The Northridge location refused to help, told me to go to emergency, and hung up without hearing my concerns. The Canoga Park location initially scheduled a same-day visit and was helpful, but the doctor did only a quick exam (no blood work) and prescribed medication.
When my family returned for follow-up, the front desk staff was rude, raised her voice, refused to let us speak to the doctor, and insisted we go to emergency. We left upset and even forgot the medication—no one called to notify us. When I called back, the same staff member was dismissive and unhelpful.
Very disappointing experience and lack of care.

The staff and Vets are professional, courteous and have been very good to my dog (even though he's a handful).  They take the time to explain any treatment or exam services that perform and always check back with me the next day to check on my dogs welfare.
Great price and really took care of Merlin our Tuxedo cat...
Got 7 yr old Bears teeth cleaned, very happy with the 90$ a month wellness plan.
Thanks for trusting us with your BFF. 🧡 We appreciate the review! …
Glad we made your experience a good one—thanks for the review! 🧡🐾 …

I’ve been taking my 13 year old dog to Banfield for years. I know my dog is receiving the best care because we’ve been to other vets and she would not walk in the door. With this location, she walks right in and jumps on the scale every time. I think that sums it up the best! I do have to add that the staff is always pleasant and less still my concerns. Dr. Del Pino cleans her teeth every year - thoughtful, kind, and explains everything. My dog and I couldn’t be happier with her care!
Love the people that work there, they are very kind with your fur babies I love taking them there. I would not take them anywhere else.
Dr Valencia and the staff At Banfield Hospital in Northridge are so amazing!! They take good care of our Baby Cloud ❤️
Everyone was very kind
Took my dog once and never again. This place just cares about money. Any little service and they charge. They don’t care about your pets health.

Dr. Hossein Amini is the best veterinarian I’ve ever worked with. He treated my dog Marley for IMPA with so much skill and compassion, and he explained every step clearly. We’re trying to find him again—does anyone know which clinic he’s at now in SoCal? (Happy to bring Marley wherever he’s practicing.) Thank you!
Dr. Inez Del Pino is an exceptional vet who is very thorough and responsive. My dog actually likes going to the vet now.
The team is AMAZING every way... Anytime I have to bring my animals in for care they are all super nice and always take care of my fur babies.
Dr Del Pino is excellent
Quick check in for drop off comprehensive exam. Dr followed up with thorough report and online report available.
Thanks for trusting us with your BFF 🧡 We appreciate the review! …
Dr del pino is the very best and is why she has been my vet for 12yrs

Almost always a good experience. Staff is knowledgeable and helpful. They remember you and your pet including medical history. The doctors are qualified and have always communicated well regarding diagnosis and treatment. I don't feel like I'm getting sold something my pet doesn't need. My dog is always shaking when I leave her there but is wagging her tail and calm when I pick her up. I've been to other Banfield offices but I drive further for this one because of the services and especially the friendly staff there.
Wow, we're wagging our tails at your rating! Your positive experience means the world to us.
I'm not very happy with this place. unprofessional and inexperienced staff. save your money go else where
Thanks for trusting us with your BFF 🧡 We appreciate the review! …
A big thank you for your pawsome review! 🐾 We hope to see you again soon. …
Your review has brightened our day! We're happy to see that you and your pet had a great experience with us.

Great visit with Dr. Nori and Jeremy. Jeremy welcomed us and really took care of business. Dr. Nori did a thorough and expert examination of my little guy Henry. What impresses me is that they are more concerned with your pet getting the best cost effective treatment, than they are about making a profit. I didn’t feel any pressure, they gave me the assessment and their primary concern was my pets wellbeing
My Sophia's Vet. Caring and efficient.
We're thrilled that you and your pet had a positive experience with us. Thanks for sharing your review!
went to another practice. this one went downhill!!

I'm very disappointed with this whole situation it's obvious you all can't be trusted. I can never get an appointment, and the people who answered the phone are very unprofessional. I emailed banfiled Cares. I overpayed for a service that I didn't even use. Never using banfieled ever again.
They always take such good care of my dog, they really care.

I have decided to delete and recreate my review for this organization as a warning to pet parents that want their pets alive. I posted here 3 months ago upset that I haven't seen a vet face-to-face in 4 YEARS after taking him in REPEATEDLY for reoccurring stomach issues that went UNDIAGNOSED. Today would have been his 7th birthday, but instead one week ago he died in my arms suddenly. This is two months AFTER I took him in for his biannual physical under his plan for them to tell me he had a clean bill of health. This is 6 weeks after I brought him back for recommended testing that a separate hospital suggested in which they told me he was fine. This is 5 weeks after they talked me into increasing my plan as they saw how desperate I was for answers I never received and never will. A plan in which they are REQUIRING I continue to pay on a DECEASED PET they NEVER diagnosed and thus his sudden death is largely on them. I will have to pay nearly 100 dollars a month FOR MONTHS despite that my beloved pet is no longer eligible for services.

This is the company you are working with. I complained several times. Do not allow them to convince you to speak to them privately. I did call and they continued to say I have to foot a bill for a service that is now impossible to receive.

I only recommend this place for periodic vaccines. Otherwise, please, I am begging you, go somewhere else. I will never not be traumatized over this.

BEWARE! DO NOT TRUST THIS PLACE!
I trusted my dog to this Banfield Northridge clinic because they were able to see her right away. Because it was a same-day appt, they said I could not go back with her because  no room, and I should pick her up in a couple hours. It took them 5 hours to get the urine they needed for the test. After the urinalysis they performed, my dog DIED later the following evening, exactly 36 hrs later.  My sweet older dog had a UTI, I was hoping to get antibiotics from them to treat her. But instead I lost my very sweet dog and companion.  She was healthy and a happy dog when I brought her in. And now I will never see her again. There is no exaggeration!
It is so unforgivable that this happened to an innocent dog who just wanted to continue walking and sniffing..... There is no recourse when you lose your pet. Nothing will bring them back.
Do not trust this clinic or the workers who are in there. They are inexperienced people who do not know what they are doing.
Dr. Del Pino is who I spoke with who treated my dog.

I brought my relatively healthy 15 y/o dog to the Banfield Pet Hospital in Northridge, CA for a UTI, so we could get her started on antibiotics.  Other then the UTI, she was fine, walking, sleeping, and eating normally.  After we picked her …
We love yo for the treat that you gave us and to our baby Thanos
Depends on the service kinda pricey

I drive a distance to be able to go the Banfield Northridge. The doctors who have tested my dogs are excellent. I'm especially impressed by the staff. The vet assistants and the front office staff are very attentive and supportive, especially when my dog was having a lot of problems.
